categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Rewrites the torcontrol fuzz harness and fixes a bug in the DynSock test utility in src/test/util/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Improves fuzz coverage for torcontrol wire parsing and fixes a broken test utility socket method. The PR description notes that line coverage of `src/torcontrol.cpp` increases from 52% to 81%, allowing fuzzing of handshake and wire-level parsing routines that were previously unreachable.
